source_summary: Vertical ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with tall dark pines on a left promontory, pale misty mountains and water across the middle distance, sparse right-bank trees, two small scholar figures in the foreground, twisted foreground pine branches, rocks, grasses, and bamboo-like shrubs. No calligraphy or seals are included as motifs.

motifs.name: left_tall_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the towering cluster of dark pines along the left edge: multiple slender trunks, a high bent crown, drooping side branches, and dense needle masses descending through the composition. Exclude the foreground scholars, lower sandbar, and distant mountains behind it.
must_preserve: long vertical trunk linework with varied ink pressure
feathery pine-needle brush texture on drooping boughs
angular broken branch tips at the high crown
dark ink accents on bark splits and exposed trunks
overlapping layered branches that create depth against the pale wash

motifs.name: misty_distant_mountains
motifs.description: Isolate the pale mid-to-background mountain range: soft triangular peaks near the center and rounded right-side hills fading into mist. Include only the mountain silhouettes and subtle ridge washes, not the left pines or foreground banks.
must_preserve: faint peak outlines emerging from atmospheric wash
soft mist edges where slopes dissolve into the background
broad pale ochre-gray tonal washes
darker sparse ridge strokes on the right hills
layered recession from central pointed peaks to rounded side slopes

motifs.name: right_bank_sparse_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow right-side shoreline with sparse leafless trees and low shrubs extending over the water. Include the thin bank line and clustered branchwork at the far right, excluding the large mountain mass behind it.
must_preserve: fine wiry branch linework
low horizontal shoreline contour
small dark shrub texture at tree bases
delicate forked twigs reaching leftward
contrast between dry brush branches and pale water wash

motifs.name: open_mist_water_surface
motifs.description: Isolate the broad quiet water or mist surface in the middle of the painting, including faint horizontal wash bands and the subtle distant shore line. Exclude foreground rocks, figures, trees, and mountain silhouettes except for the water-level atmospheric edges.
must_preserve: nearly empty ink-wash expanse
soft horizontal tonal transitions
thin distant shoreline strokes
muted atmospheric gradation from mountain base to foreground
quiet negative-space character essential to the composition

motifs.name: left_rocky_promontory
motifs.description: Isolate the rocky ledge and sloping promontory beneath the left pines: dark ink rocks, root-like forms, grass tufts, and the pale sloping ground plane. Exclude the vertical pine trunks above as much as possible and exclude the foreground figures.
must_preserve: bold dark rock outlines and angular cuts
dry-brush texture on rock faces
tufted grasses along the lower edge
curving pale bank contour
ink pooling and wash variation at the ledge base

motifs.name: low_bamboo_shrub_sprays
motifs.description: Isolate the low bamboo-like shrub sprays stretching from the base of the left promontory toward the center: thin branching stems with small pointed leaves and light ink clusters. Do not include the tall pine trunks or the scholar figures.
must_preserve: fine calligraphic stems
small pointed leaf clusters in repeated sprays
light dry-brush leaf tips
arching horizontal growth direction
delicate overlap with the pale ground wash

motifs.name: two_scholar_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the two small foreground scholar figures standing on the bank: one upright robed figure with a dark head and long robe, and one seated or crouched companion nearby. Include their immediate ink shadows only, not the surrounding rocks or tree branches.
must_preserve: thin robe contour lines
dark hair or cap accents
subtle pale robe wash
small gestural posture differences between standing and seated figures
minimal ground-shadow strokes anchoring the figures

motifs.name: twisted_foreground_pine_branch
motifs.description: Isolate the large low twisted foreground tree and branch system sweeping across the lower right: sinuous trunk, exposed roots, bare twigs, and sparse pine-needle clusters at the far right and lower base. Exclude the two scholars and bottom-left rocks.
must_preserve: sinuous dark trunk contour with knot-like bends
fine bare twig extensions
fan-like sparse pine needles at branch ends
dry-brush bark texture and dark ink accents
root-like forms gripping the foreground bank

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
